nodes.label: Reports and exports
nodes.rationale: Every report is queued from the Reports page, written by the export worker, and downloaded by id. The note covers file formats and the NAAC/NBA accreditation templates.

nodes.label: Report export queue
nodes.rationale: POST /api/reports queues the job. services/export_jobs.py writes the file. GET /api/reports/id/download returns it. The users, audit-log and timetable bulk exports stream row by row and stay CSV; they are not this queue.

nodes.label: CSV Excel and PDF renderers
nodes.rationale: services/reports_admin/renderers.py takes the same dataset for csv, xlsx and pdf, so the three formats cannot drift. Excel and PDF add a title block that records the filters. PDF is landscape when there are more than seven columns. The download mimetype comes from the file extension.

nodes.label: NAAC and NBA accreditation templates
nodes.rationale: The attendance templates use the same attendance_calc figures the screens show, so a binder printout agrees with the dashboard. Types are defaulters, subject-wise, monthly-register, faculty-workload, syllabus-coverage and co-attainment. syllabus-coverage is listed only while syllabus is on. co-attainment is the NBA outcome table and is listed only while assessments is on. An empty file is produced when the capability is off. faculty-workload adds norm columns only while workload_norms is on.

nodes.label: Exam seating and hall tickets
nodes.rationale: Exam seating plans and hall tickets use the same PDF renderer but are not queued report types. They download from the exam while capability exams is on.
